prompt: Describe a standard O(n log n) algorithm to merge overlapping closed intervals, and clarify whether touching intervals merge.
target: Sort intervals by start. Iterate in order: if the result is empty or the next start is greater than the last end, append a new interval; otherwise replace the last interval with one whose end is the maximum of both ends. Sorting costs O(n log n), the scan O(n), and output storage O(n). For closed intervals, [1,2] and [2,3] overlap at 2 and merge; if touching endpoints should not merge, use a strict comparison according to that contract.
